provenance.notes: Manually reconstructed from the inspected original flattened PDF figure. Ordinary labels are live typeable text; panels, graph geometry and arrows are native editable shapes or paths. Source layout and contents retained; font metrics, line widths and decorative effects approximated. Four original scene photographs are isolated raster crops. All stage titles, VLMs, database/document symbols, decision/router shapes, status blocks and connecting arrows are native.
